steps.code:
# Get the current song and the liked songs
access_token = login_result['access_token']
current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current_song)

# Get liked songs (all pages)
liked_songs = []
page = 0
while True:
    result = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page, page_limit=20)
    if not result:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(result)
    if len(result) < 20:
        break
    page += 1
print("Liked songs count:", len(liked_songs))
print("Liked song IDs:", [s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs])

steps.code:
# Check if current song is liked, if not, go to next song until we find a liked one
liked_ids = {s['song_id'] for s in liked_songs}
current_id = current_song['song_id']
steps = 0
while current_id not in liked_ids and steps < 100:
    # Skip to next song
    apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    # Get the new current song
    current_song = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    current_id = current_song['song_id']
    steps += 1
    print(f"Step {steps}: now on song {current_id} - {current_song['title']}")

print("Reached liked song:", current_song['title'], "ID:", current_id)
